title: The True Contributors: Who Actually Moves the Table?
excerpt: Applies the expected-points value model from project 02 to rank players whose true contribution diverges from their box-score reputation. Scorer, assist-creator and pre-assist-creator all credited.
finding: Julian Brandt creates more pre-assist value than any player in Europe except Lionel Messi — 40.93 EP from SCA2 alone, 39% of his total contribution.
